title: Marvelous Designer 2024.0 New Feature - Video Capture
description: Thank you all for your continued support; Marvelous Designer 2024.0 has been officially released!
transcript:
Hello everyone, in this video we will learn how to use the video capture function.
Through the video capture function, you can capture the animation seen in the 3D window into a video.
You can use the main menu animation video capture or go to the animation editor tool bar to find this function.
First, please set the starting point and end point of the play area.
Then click on the video capture button to start recording.
When capturing the video, the video capture button will become the stop button.
You can click on this button to stop the video capture.
When the video capture is automatically finished or stopped, the captured video will automatically be played in your default player.
In the video capture setting, you can choose the size of the video to capture according to your needs.
When selecting a custom image, you can freely set the size.
If you choose full screen, the size of the video will be the size of your display.
For window, the size of the 3D window is the size of the video.
You can choose the format to save under the file selection.
You can choose to save the captured video as a file.
After selecting this option, you can set the name of the video and save the path.
After setting, click on Capture.
Please note that video capture is not possible without animation.
In addition, the video capture function is based on the 3D window.
The current lens captures the video, so you can only capture the animation seen in the current 3D window.
Thank you for watching. See you in the next video.
Thank you for watching.
summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2024.0 New Feature - Video Capture ## Introduction Hello everyone, in this video we will learn how to use the video capture function. ## Video Capture Functionality Through the video capture function, you can capture the animation seen in the 3D window into a video. You can access this feature via the main menu under "Animation" or go to the Animation Editor toolbar to find this function. ## Setting the Play Area First, please set the starting point and end point of the play area. ## Starting the Capture Then click on the video capture button to start recording. When capturing the video, the video capture button will change to a stop button. You can click on this button to stop the video capture. ## Playback of Captured Video When the video capture is automatically finished or stopped, the captured video will automatically be played in your default player. ## Video Capture Settings In the video capture settings, you can choose the size of the video to capture according to your needs. ### Custom Image Size When selecting a custom image, you can freely set the size. If you choose full screen, the size of the video will match the size of your display. For the window option, the size of the captured video will correspond to the size of the 3D window. ### File Format and Saving You can choose the format to save under the file selection. Additionally, you can choose to save the captured video as a file. After selecting this option, you can set the name of the video and the save path. After setting, click on "Capture." ## Important Notes Please note that video capture is not possible without animation. In addition, the video capture function is based on the 3D window. The current lens captures the video, so you can only capture the animation seen in the current 3D window. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching. See you in the next video. ```
